name: DeviceProcessEvents
description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process creation and execution events

columns.name: Timestamp
columns.description: Timestamp when the process event occurred

columns.name: DeviceId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the device in Defender

columns.name: DeviceName
columns.description: Fully qualified domain name or hostname of the device

columns.name: FolderPath
columns.description: Directory folder containing the process executable

columns.name: SHA256
columns.description: SHA-256 hash of the process executable

columns.name: ProcessCommandLine
columns.description: Command line used to create the new process

columns.name: AccountName
columns.description: User account name executing the process

columns.name: InitiatingProcessCommandLine
columns.description: Command line of the parent process

columns.name: InitiatingProcessAccountName
columns.description: Account that launched the parent process
